title: Check the named bean's generic type before returning it
summary: Named generic lookup now rejects the count bean as Box<String> in Java and Kotlin. Both languages report the bean name, raw and generic requirement, and actual class, and both retrieve the same Box<Number> singleton.

change.description: The new BeanFactory.getBean(String, `ParameterizedTypeReference<T>`) checks the object found by name and exposes a parameterized required type on failure. Kotlin's reified named lookup now passes a type reference.

notes: The Kotlin client was compiled against each revision because the extension is inline. The parent Kotlin binary accepted the mismatched count singleton.
